schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).

main.note: names guessed (errors, nfiles, progname, wflag, usage). The usage message is an initialised array usage[] (the original has it in the data, padded to an even length, in front of the string pool), not a literal. An argument starting with - is -w whatever its letter; with no argument at all **argv reads the null pointer (quirks table).

dowhat.note: the string after @[$] is read by for (c = getc(fp); c && ...; c = getc(fp)) (two getc: the original shares their halves); the loop does not stop at EOF and a character that breaks the pattern is not tested again (quirks table).

note: a WEGA program (qcv(5)) without a System III source, written from the disassembly; byte-identical with ccv1, the stdio.h of oldv7 and libc-v4.a.
